verdict.rationale: Jules supports one built-in event trigger (assigning the 'jules' label in GitHub issues auto-starts a task) and exposes an API that lets developers build custom automations/workflows triggered by external events (e.g., Slack, Linear, GitHub), per jules-docs-2, jules-docs-9, and jules-docs-16. However, there is no evidence of a native, user-configurable rules/trigger engine inside Jules itself (e.g., 'if X happens, do Y') — building automation requires external glue code via the API. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/trigger builder UI, support for multiple event types beyond the GitHub label, and independent confirmation of custom automation workflows in practice.
